subject: Procurement: PO guidance, net terms & invoice cadence for Redwood engagement
messages:
From: Brian Caldwell <brian.caldwell@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Procurement: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this week. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we can route the PO:

- Do you require a single PO per invoice, or can we issue a master PO that covers multiple invoices for the term?
- What payment terms do you accept (Net 30/45/60)?
- Do you need any specific PO fields populated (e.g., Redwood SOW reference, deal ID, vendor tax ID)?
- What supporting docs do you need up front (W-9, contract signature page, bank instructions)?

Also attached is our standard PO template (ACME_PO_TEMPLATE.pdf). If you can fill in the remit-to and confirm the billing cadence, that will help speed things up.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is aiming to get the PO out next week.

Best,
Brian
Brian Caldwell
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

--
Attachment: ACME_PO_TEMPLATE.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Brian Caldwell <brian.caldwell@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Brian — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a couple of asks so we can align with finance and legal: 

- Master PO: We can accept a master PO that references specific invoice numbers, or a single PO per invoice — either works. If you want a master PO, please include language that allows Redwood to submit sequential invoice numbers under that PO number.
- Net terms: Standard is Net 30. For enterprise purchases we can offer Net 45 on approved credit; Net 60 would need finance escalation.
- PO fields: Please include the Deal ID (ACME-2025-01) in the PO reference field and the Redwood SOW number if available. Vendor tax ID and remit address should be populated on the PO.
- Supporting docs: We require a signed order form (signature page) and a completed W-9 for US vendors. Bank wiring instructions are used only for ACH/wire payments — we can provide upon request.

Discounts/packaging: The pricing in the quote is tied to term commitments. As discussed, we can extend a term-based discount: 7.5% for a 12-month committed purchase, 5% for 6 months. Discounts require the PO to reference the committed term and deal ID. If procurement needs this embedded in the PO language, we can provide sample wording.

Sending over the commercial quote now (quote-ACME-2025-02.pdf). Dev — can you confirm whether quarterly invoicing causes any technical billing or metering complications on our side?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachments: quote-ACME-2025-02.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Brian Caldwell <brian.caldwell@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Feb 2025 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Marissa — thanks. Procurement filled out our template and attached it for your review (acme_po_signed.pdf). A few clarifying items from finance: 

- Preferred cadence: Our standard is quarterly invoicing with Net 45. Can Redwood accept quarterly invoices with Net 45 terms?
- Master PO: We typically issue a master PO that covers the year, then reference that master PO on each quarterly invoice. Will Redwood accept that approach?
- W-9 & bank details: Please send your W-9 and bank remit instructions so we can set you up in our AP system.

We also need confirmation that the 7.5% discount is applied to the committed annual spend and that refunds/credits are handled if actual usage is below commitment.

Attached: acme_po_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks — if you can confirm by EOD we can route this through AP next week.

Brian
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Brian Caldwell <brian.caldwell@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Feb 2025 12:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Hi Brian — quick technical/ops notes from billing: 

- Quarterly invoicing with Net 45 is fine from a systems perspective. We can generate invoices each quarter that reference the master PO and sequential invoice numbers.
- For committed-term discounts: discounts are applied at invoice generation time based on the committed annual quantity. If actual usage falls below commitment we net against future invoices or issue a credit per the order form language. We typically reconcile usage quarterly.
- Finance needs the following fields on the PO: Remit-To (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Federal Tax ID (XX-XXXXXXX), and the Deal ID in the PO reference. I attached our W-9 for your AP team.

Marissa — if procurement will issue a master PO, we need explicit language allowing Redwood to invoice under that number for multiple invoice IDs. Also flagging that our standard 7.5% annual-commit discount is contingent on the commitment being non-cancelable for the term or with a short pro-rata true-up. If procurement prefers refundable credits, that changes the commercial structure.

Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

--
Attachment: W-9_Redwood.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Brian Caldwell <brian.caldwell@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Feb 2025 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements & invoicing cadence for Redwood contract

Brian — appreciate the speedy response and the filled PO. Confirming and next steps below: 

1) Master PO + Quarterly invoicing: Confirmed — Redwood will accept a master PO that covers the contracted term. Each invoice will reference the master PO number and include its own invoice number. Quarterly invoices with Net 45 are acceptable.

2) Discounts & reconciliation: 7.5% discount will apply to the committed annual spend and be reflected on each invoice. If actual usage is below the committed amount, we will perform a quarterly reconciliation and apply credits to future invoices (or issue a single credit at year-end per your preference) — please indicate your preference on that point.

3) Docs: Attached are the Redwood W-9 and a copy of the signature page we need returned with the PO (we prefer the signature page to reference Deal ID ACME-2025-01). Once we have the signed order form and noted master PO number, finance can proceed to set up quarterly payments.

4) Language for PO (suggested): 
   - "Redwood Inference to invoice under Master PO #XXXX for sequential invoice numbers; Net 45 payment terms; discount of 7.5% on committed annual spend (Deal ID ACME-2025-01)."

Please confirm: (a) will Acme issue a master PO covering the term? (b) does AP want credits applied quarterly or as a year-end reconciliation? (c) expected date for the signed order form back to us?

If you want, we can draft a short PO amendment text for your procurement team. Thanks again — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
